body_html:
The Global Duet stacking table turns any room into a flexible space that shifts from focused training to open collaboration in minutes. Its one-piece polypropylene worksurface flows in a clean waterfall profile into a built-in modesty panel, and the lightweight chrome-frame design lets staff reconfigure, stack and store tables without a second set of hands. A practical, hard-wearing choice for schools, training rooms and staff breakrooms.

Features

  • One-piece polypropylene worksurface with a waterfall profile that extends into a 9.75" (248 mm) front modesty panel
  • Lightweight and durable, so rooms can be reconfigured for lectures, testing or group work in seconds
  • Stacks up to five high on the floor or twenty high on an optional dolly for compact storage
  • Underside bumpers protect worksurfaces when tables are stacked
  • Scratch-resistant, easy-to-clean top on a chrome-plated 0.5" solid steel frame
  • Optional ADA-compliant frame accommodates wheelchair access
  • Pairs with Global Duet stacking chairs for a coordinated room

Specifications

Measures 29"W x 25"D x 28"H with a 250 lb weight capacity, available in ten contemporary polypropylene colours. Backed by a 5-year limited warranty on non-moving parts.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964, 296 George St N, Peterborough ON) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing and colour matching, or Call 1-800-835-9565.
